summary: Massive drone and cruise missile wave targets multiple Ukrainian regions simultaneously, with 12-15 Banderole cruise missiles hitting Odesa and reactive/strike drones flooding Zhytomyr, Chernihiv, Kyiv, and Poltava oblasts. Russian forces claim liberation of Dobropillie and Svitle Dolyna in Donbas, threatening VSU logistics. Ukraine signaled openness to grain truce and energy ceasefire, while Zelensky offered three-way G20 meeting with Trump and Putin.
key_points: 12-15 Banderole cruise missiles struck Odesa overnight, with infrastructure and commercial targets hit (Source: @mon1tor_ua/75686, @mon1tor_ua/75687, @ukr_leaks_eng/33477).

Reactive and strike drones mass across Zhytomyr: multiple groups targeting Korosten, Baranivka, Tetiivka, Khoroshiv, Ovruch, Andrushivka, Chudniv, Pulini, Rzhyshchiv (Source: @eRadarrua/116521, @kpszsu/79936, @kpszsu/79957).

5 groups of strike drones and 2 groups of reactive drones reported in Chernihiv direction past Horodnya toward Slavutych, plus 1 drone on Belarus territory (Source: @eRadarrua/116544, @eRadarrua/116525, @eRadarrua/116539).

Reactive drones launched from north Dnipropetrovsk toward Poltava, and between Poltava-Kremenchuk heading west; strike drones north Zaporizhzhia toward Dnipropetrovsk with KABs on Donetsk (Source: @kpszsu/79933, @kpszsu/79959, @kpszsu/79947).

Russian MoD claims VSRF liberated Dobropillie and Svitle Dolyna, controlling Dobropillie would disrupt VSU logistics and enable advance to DNR border (Source: @tass_agency/397177, @tass_agency/397170, @tass_agency/397171).
Ukraine agreed to three de-escalation steps: mutual energy infrastructure ceasefire, Black Sea grain corridor restoration, trilateral US-Ukraine-Russia meeting (Source: @UkraineNow/84281).
Zelensky told Russian journalist he would visit Moscow 'on a missile'; offered three-way Trump-Putin meeting at G20 Miami (Source: @ukr_leaks_eng/33475, @ukr_leaks_eng/33478).
NABU searched former Defense Procurement head Arsen Zhumadilov's offices, found $140M packed in fridge boxes marked 'for the servant of the people' (Source: @ukr_leaks_eng/33490).

sections.executive_summary: A large-scale aerial assault wave struck multiple Ukrainian oblasts simultaneously, with 12-15 Banderole cruise missiles hitting Odesa and dozens of reactive and strike drones targeting Zhytomyr, Chernihiv, Kyiv, Poltava, and Dnipropetrovsk regions. Russian forces claim liberation of Dobropillie and Svitle Dolyna in Donbas, threatening Ukrainian logistics. Ukraine signaled openness to grain truce and energy ceasefire while Zelensky offered a three-way G20 meeting with Trump and Putin.
ukraine: NABU conducted search at former Defense Procurement head Arsen Zhumadilov's offices, found $140 million in refrigerator boxes, one marked 'for the servant of the people' (Source: @ukr_leaks_eng/33490).
Zelensky stated ready for three-way meeting with Trump and Putin at G20 Miami; also told Russian journalist he would visit Moscow 'on a missile' (Source: @ukr_leaks_eng/33478, @ukr_leaks_eng/33475).
Ukraine agreed to three de-escalation steps: mutual ceasefire on energy infrastructure, restoration of Black Sea grain corridor, trilateral US-Ukraine-Russia meeting (Source: @UkraineNow/84281).
Ukraine open to grain truce with Russia, stated Deputy PM Chentsov: 'step by step we can eventually discuss something more comprehensive' (Source: @ukr_leaks_eng/33464).

Zelensky-von der Leyen meeting in New York was tense; Europeans demanded shadow economy crackdown, tax revenue, legislation alignment; Ukraine raised air defense shortage (Source: @ukr_leaks_eng/33465).
US Secretary Rubio acknowledged limited/temporary ceasefires would not end the conflict (Source: @ukr_leaks_eng/33468).
Demographer Ella Libanova warned sending young people to front would cause significantly higher mortality among youth (Source: @ukr_leaks_eng/33483).
russia: Russian MoD claims VSRF liberated Dobropillie and Svitle Dolyna in Donetsk region; controlling Dobropillie would disrupt VSU logistics from Dnipropetrovsk (Source: @tass_agency/397177, @tass_agency/397170).
Russian forces reported taking high ground near Dobropillie would accelerate advance to DNR border; VSU striving to deblockade grouping (Source: @tass_agency/397171).
Kremlin did not record Zelensky refusing invitation to Moscow, said Peskov; Dmitriev called trilateral talks in US a fake (Source: @tass_agency/397177, @UkraineNow/84274).

Russia's 2027-2029 budget accounts for current challenges; tax payment deadline December 1 for 2025 income including deposits, Kursk oblast extensions (Source: @tass_agency/397177, @tass_agency/397180).
Medvedev called ER Duma election results historical success; ER may get 349 seats; Gоловin proposed for youth committee (Source: @tass_agency/397142, @tass_agency/397177).
EU carefully hides regular refutations of Moscow's claims about plans to attack Europe, said Russian MFA envoy Polyansky (Source: @tass_agency/397144).
eastern_front: Russian MoD claims control of Dobropillie and Svitle Dolyna, a key logistics artery for VSU from Dnipropetrovsk into Donbas (Source: @tass_agency/397177, @tass_agency/397170).
Ukrainian forces struck Russian radar 35N6 'Kasta' and P-18 in TOT Zaporizhzhia; hit strike drone storage/prep/launch near occupied Donetsk (Source: @UkraineNow/84277).

Reactive drones between Poltava and Kremenchuk heading west, originating from eastern directions (Source: @kpszsu/79959, @kpszsu/79935).
ISW reports ZSU advanced in Kharkiv, Donetsk, and Zaporizhzhia directions over recent days; Ukrainian forces thwarted offensive operations on most front directions (Source: @UkraineNow/84280).

Reactive drone east of Kyiv heading west; reactive drone north of Cherkasy heading west (Source: @kpszsu/79961).

Shahed detected on Troieshchyna Kyiv; regular Shahed over Lutsk on Pidhaytsi, Boratyn, Lyshche (Source: @mon1tor_ua/75669, @mon1tor_ua/75679, @mon1tor_ua/75676).

Reactive drone on Korosten Zhytomyr from east; strike drone from Narodychi toward Korosten (Source: @kpszsu/79934, @eRadarrua/116523).
Reactive drone SE Zhytomyr heading south; strike drone Slavutych (Source: @kpszsu/79972, @eRadarrua/116535).

Reactive drone Starokostiantyniv Khmelnytskyi; reactive drone north Chudniv Zhytomyr toward Khmelnytskyi (Source: @mon1tor_ua/75653, @kpszsu/79957).

air_war: 12-15 Banderole cruise missiles targeted Odesa; 'New Line' hypermarket destroyed (Source: @mon1tor_ua/75686, @mon1tor_ua/75687, @ukr_leaks_eng/33477).
Multiple Shahed drones across Zhytomyr, Kyiv, Lutsk, Starokostiantyniv; up to 20 new regular Shaheds on Chernihiv (Source: @mon1tor_ua/75675, @mon1tor_ua/75670, @mon1tor_ua/75672, @mon1tor_ua/75676).

Reactive drones from north toward Zhytomyr; strike drones 4-5 groups in Chernihiv direction; 2 reactive groups Kyiv; 1 reactive Dnipropetrovsk (Source: @eRadarrua/116544, @eRadarrua/116540, @kpszsu/79936).
Drone threat yellow level in Kyiv 13:21 and 13:46 24.09.2026; air raid alerts active across multiple oblasts (Source: @eRadarrua/116506, @eRadarrua/116509).

Ukrainian forces destroyed Russian radar 35N6 'Kasta' and P-18 in TOT Zaporizhzhia; also hit fuel depot and drone launch sites (Source: @UkraineNow/84277).
key_developments: 12-15 Banderole cruise missiles struck Odesa, hitting 'New Line' hypermarket and infrastructure; threat continues to escalate along southern coast (Source: @mon1tor_ua/75686, @ukr_leaks_eng/33477).

Massive drone wave: reactive and strike drones target Zhytomyr, Chernihiv, Kyiv, Poltava, Dnipropetrovsk simultaneously from multiple axes including Ovruch, Narodychi, Horodnya (Source: @eRadarrua/116521, @eRadarrua/116525).

Russian forces claim liberation of Dobropillie and Svitle Dolyna in Donbas, threatening VSU logistics corridor from Dnipropetrovsk; high ground near Dobropillie enables advance to DNR border (Source: @tass_agency/397177, @tass_agency/397171).

Ukraine agreed to three de-escalation steps: energy infrastructure ceasefire, grain corridor restoration, trilateral US-Ukraine-Russia meeting; Zelensky offered G20 Miami three-way format (Source: @UkraineNow/84281, @ukr_leaks_eng/33478).
Russian strike destroyed MiroHost data center in Kyiv, disrupted internet for 100,000+ households; also affected Cityhost, UTELS, Etherlink providers (Source: @eRadarrua/116531).
CIA warned Spain, France, Italy of potential Russian drone attacks from Black Sea ships targeting European territory to weaken Ukraine support and divide NATO (Source: @ukr_leaks_eng/33480).
NABU found $140 million in former Defense Procurement head Zhumadilov's offices packed in fridge boxes; corruption probe escalates amid wartime procurement scrutiny (Source: @ukr_leaks_eng/33490).
sections.threat_assessment: The simultaneous drone and cruise missile wave across multiple oblasts indicates a coordinated escalation by Russian forces, targeting energy infrastructure, logistics nodes, and civilian areas. The destruction of MiroHost data center in Kyiv represents a deliberate strike on digital infrastructure alongside physical targets. CIA warnings of Russian drone attacks on Europe from Black Sea ships suggest expanding threat dimensionality against NATO territory. Russian claims of Dobropillie liberation signal potential offensive momentum in Donbas logistics corridor. Ukraine's openness to grain truce and energy ceasefire suggests diplomatic openings, but Rubio's statement that temporary ceasefires won't end the conflict indicates limited near-term de-escalation prospects.
sections.regional_response: European officials demanded Ukraine address shadow economy and tax gaps during Zelensky-von der Leyen meeting, linking financial accountability to continued support. Erdogan condemned both Russia and Ukraine for Black Sea ship attacks including Turkish vessels, signaling diplomatic pressure on both parties. Trump's meeting with Xi Jinping in Washington precedes Dmitriev's US visit for Witkoff-Kushner talks, placing Ukraine negotiations within broader US-China geopolitical context. Medvedev's celebration of ER Duma victory and proposed leadership changes indicate Russian domestic political consolidation amid wartime governance.
sections.intelligence_notes: The volume and multi-axis nature of drone strikes suggests Russian forces are testing Ukrainian air defense saturation across Zhytomyr, Chernihiv, Kyiv, and Poltava simultaneously. The $140M procurement corruption finding at Zhumadilov's offices may indicate systemic issues in defense acquisition affecting weapon supply timelines. CIA warning on Russian drones from Black Sea ships to Europe implies intelligence sharing with NATO members Spain, France, Italy ahead of potential escalation. ISW confirmation of Ukrainian advances in Kharkiv, Donetsk, and Zaporizhzhia contradicts Russian claims of Dobropillie liberation, suggesting contested frontline dynamics.
